设计意图： Mutation of regime_vol_adaptive_trend_v3: increased intraday pressure window to 5 for smoother mean-reversion signal, and simplified momentum branch to use raw 10-day rate of change (removed double smoothing) for more responsive trend capture. Volume ratio scaling is preserved as the lightweight modifier, and regime switching via style_gate_resvol_high remains the core mechanism.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), multiply(ts_mean(divide(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-08)), 5), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))), multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)), 1), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))))
  2. 2. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  3. 3. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_mean(divide(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-08)), 5), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)))
  5. 5. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-08)), 5)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-08))
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen)
  8. 8. add —— 加法
    add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-08)
  9. 9. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  11. 11. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  12. 12. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)), 1), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)))
  13. 13. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)), 1)
  14. 14. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10))
  15. 15. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)
  16. 16. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  17. 17. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_resvol：style_gate_resvol_high > 0
  2. 计算 imp：(close - open) / (high - low + 1e-8)
  3. 计算 imp：imp.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=5).mean()
  4. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(10) - 1
  5. 计算 factor：np.where(high_resvol, imp * vol_ratio, mom * vol_ratio)
  6. 计算 factor：pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_regime_vol_adaptive_trend_v4(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_resvol = df_copy["str">'style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0 imp = (df_copy["str">'close'] - df_copy["str">'open']) / (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] + 1e-8) imp = imp.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean() mom = df_copy["str">'close'] / df_copy["str">'close'].shift(10) - 1 _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["str">'volume'], window=20) factor = np.where(high_resvol, imp * vol_ratio, mom * vol_ratio) factor = pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_regime_vol_adaptive_trend_v4'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_regime_vol_adaptive_trend_v4']
